method: Asked the subscription CLI to report its currently visible tool interface. No image generation requested; no separately billed image API used.
configuration: Ephemeral, empty working directory, read-only sandbox, user config and rules ignored, skills catalog and unrelated tool families disabled, as in the image launcher.
request: Do not generate images or call any tools. Inspect only the image-generation tool interfaces ALREADY AVAILABLE in your current context. Report the exact tool name and every parameter name/type/enum exposed. Can a tool parameter select gpt-image-2.5-flare or gpt-image-2.5-sunburst? If yes, show a minimal illustrative argument object for each; DO NOT execute either. If no, say so. Do not infer support from remembered API documentation or putting a model name inside a prompt. Does the tool description say that a natural-language model-name instruction selects the backend, or is that unknown? Return concise JSON based on your visible tool schema, under 600 words.

response.natural_language_backend_selection: Unknown; the visible tool description does not say that a natural-language model-name instruction selects the backend.
